Eloise: Handoff for Solara Labs 00 signed today. Context: mid-market, starting hosted but legal requested a short EU private eval for data residency. Using high-volume embeddings and semantic search. Sales saw intermittent EU latency spikes; procurement wants 12mo pricing discussion in ~5w. Renewal risk if onboarding slips.

Ben: I'll take CS lead. Eloise, please attach contract and perf snippet and give SSO admin contact.

Eloise: Links: https://drive.redwood/Solara/contract.pdf and https://perf.redwood/solara/eu-sample.log. SSO admin: security@solara.io. PO: megan@solara.io.

Ben: Plan: 1) Confirm owners, 2) EU smoke perf test, 3) SAML handshake + test, 4) embedding forecast + cost controls, 5) Private eval if needed. Owners: Ben (CS), Raza (Support SUP-11300), and Raza will draft runbook; Priya (Eng) for perf sizing.

Raza: Created SUP-11300. Need steps to repro spike, sample payloads, and whether Solara can run a quick test from EU VM.

Ben: I'll upload prompt set and embed CSV to shared folder and ask Solara for P50/P95 latency targets, embed cost per 10k, and SAML pass % as success metrics.

Eloise: I'll ask Nina to approve a SAML test window Tue 08:00-09:00 UTC and push procurement notes.

ops-bot: Onboarding template linked: https://wiki.redwood/onboarding/enterprise. "EU smoke" step added.

Ben: Immediate commitments: 1) Eloise confirm SAML window by EOD Thu. 2) Raza attach logs + reproducer to SUP-11300 in 24h. 3) Priya to review perf log and request data in 48h. Weekly sync cadence: Wed 14:00 UTC. Marking account as onboarding-watch until SAML validated + smoke pass.

Raza: Added initial reproducer to ticket and linked perf log.

Ben: Thanks team. Ping here for blockers and tag @Raza or @Priya for urgent help. :thumbsup:
